channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Michael Jordan | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Michael Jordan from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mike Tirico on Michael Jordan
item.description:
“He likes being Michael Jordan. Even still, when he’s on camera, there’s an aura about Michael Jordan that is just different. Sitting across from him. It’s just a different feel. I think he is above the daily discourse of, ‘Hey, who is the best point guard in the NBA right now?’ and ‘who’s the best this or the best that?’”

Mike Tirico on Michael Jordan, Oct 14, 2026. Source: Front Office Sports.

item.description:

Mike Tirico on Michael Jordan, Oct 13, 2026. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Mike Tirico on Michael Jordan
item.description:
summit in New York on Tuesday, Tirico explained that Jordan ultimately didn’t want to deal with the day-to-day of a broadcaster at this point in his life.

“I think Michael Jordan hadn’t been on TV for a long time for a reason,”

Mike Tirico on Michael Jordan, Oct 13, 2026. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Brian Scalabrine on Michael Jordan, Phil Jackson, Joe Mazzulla
item.description:
Scalabrine then talked about the advice that Jordan shared with Mazzulla in his hangouts with the two NBA legends.

“He [Mazzulla] told them at the partners' summit that he actually hung out with Michael Jordan and Phil Jackson this summer. And Jordan told Joe that 'the reason why I kept winning was I acted like I never won,'”

Brian Scalabrine on Michael Jordan, Phil Jackson, Joe Mazzulla, Sep 23, 2026. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Brian Scalabrine on Michael Jordan
item.description:
“If you act as if you've never done anything, then you are hungry to continue to get it. And he goes, Jordan was like that. That was his message to Joe.”

Brian Scalabrine on Michael Jordan, Sep 23, 2026. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Draymond Green on LeBron James, Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“You remember the day and age where Michael Jordan was celebrated, not ridiculed like LeBron James. The coverage of basketball as a whole was completely different. I grew up in that era, and now, being one of the players, and seeing that that's not a thing at all, nowadays, we want to talk about, I can't remember a single time where someone said, 'Man, Scottie Pippen need to win this game or his legacy is tarnished.'”

Draymond Green on LeBron James, Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Sep 21, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kwame Brown on Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen
item.description:
Kwame Brown:

“Stackhouse one day told (Michael Jordan), I didn't come here to be your Scottie Pippen. He thought that he was going to be the number one option and then MJ would be backing him up, but he found out very quickly that that wasn't the case and MJ was the number one option and Stack had to get in where he fit in.”

Kwame Brown on Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Sep 21, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kwame Brown on Michael Jordan
item.description:
Kwame Brown:

“I think Kobe worked a little bit harder on defense, and he was obsessing over Michael Jordan a little bit. I remember he would practice carrying the little 45-pound dumbbells all around the court because his hands weren't as big as Michael Jordan. I think that is the only thing that set them apart. Michael Jordan's hands are like mitts. Kobe's hands are regular. So he had to work on his hand strength, so he would walk around the court with these 45-pound dumbbells on each hand, and every morning you see him doing that just to make sure he had his hand strength together. I am like, damn, let me try that too. He would pick up different traits. I never seen somebody do that.”

Kwame Brown on Michael Jordan, Sep 19, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Blake Griffin on Michael Jordan
item.description:
Blake Griffin:

“I think Michael Jordan is the goat because he had the best career of all time.”

Blake Griffin on Michael Jordan, Sep 17, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Richard Jefferson on LeBron James, Kobe Bryant, Michael Jordan, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Bill Russell
item.description:
Richard Jefferson:

“There is no GOAT in basketball because there's multiple levels. Kareem Abdul-Jabbar I think had the greatest career, Bill Russell won the most championships, Michael Jordan is the icon, and I think Kobe Bryant and what he did mentally for the game and really for athletes all around the world. ButI would just say if you were to build a basketball player, you could not build a better basketball player than LeBron James. There's no skill set he doesn't have, there's no physical ability. So for me, if I was building a basketball player, mentally and physically, he would be the person that I would build.”

Richard Jefferson on LeBron James, Kobe Bryant, Michael Jordan, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Bill Russell, Sep 12, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: LeBron James on Michael Jordan
item.description:
Mario Chalmers says Michael Jordan is the GOAT and NOBODY fears LeBron:

“This man was 6-0 in the finals. He dominated the 90s basically. Yes Bron went to 9 straight finals but Jordan dominated a decade. There’s only been 3 teams to win a ring in the 90s. You go to Brons era, there’s been 4-5. — Why isn’t LeBron being compared to Pippen? — Nobody fears Bron. Nobody is like ‘damn I gotta go play against Bron tonight.’ Nobody said that. I seen people be scared when they actually line up to him but they’re not scared thinking about that match up”

LeBron James on Michael Jordan, Aug 7, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Michael Jordan
item.description:
Jaylen Brown:

“I had a good convo with Michael Jordan and he was like, one thing I want you to work on is your efficiency. You're efficient, but even more efficient. Don't waste no energy, no motion, no movement while you're on the court.”

Jaylen Brown on Michael Jordan, Jul 28, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Donald Trump on LeBron James, Michael Jordan
item.description:
Trump said in the Oval Office.

“I think LeBron is — maybe he’s a racist. But maybe he doesn’t like Trump. I don’t know. I only like people that like me. So I would say Michael Jordan all the way.”

Donald Trump on LeBron James, Michael Jordan, Jul 24, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: LeBron James on Michael Jordan
item.description:
LeBron James, on his basketball mortality:

“My favorite basketball player of all-time and my inspiration was Michael Jordan. There was an end for him. If there was an end for one of the greatest to ever play the game of basketball, it's inevitable it's going to happen to all of us.”

LeBron James on Michael Jordan, Jul 16, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: AJ Dybantsa on Michael Jordan
item.description:
AJ Dybantsa:

“I seen him on TikTok, there was a dude that put me better than Michael Jordan. I believe Michael Jordan is the GOAT, so I decided to watch the video and see he was 6'6, 220 with a 40-inch vertical, and I was like that kind of sounds like me. So I decided to watch some film, I seen him get into his mid-range a lot and I take pride in my mid-range, so I kind of seen the comparison a little bit.”

AJ Dybantsa on Michael Jordan, Jun 26, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Tiago Splitter on Michael Jordan
item.description:
“Growing up in Brazil, I watched many games late at night, hidden from my parents at 1 am, watching MJ [Michael -Jordan] games and rooting for the Bulls. So super excited to be here.”

Tiago Splitter on Michael Jordan, Jun 19, 2026. Source: Chicago Sun-Times.

item.title: JR Smith on Michael Jordan, Patrick Ewing, John Starks
item.description:
JR Smith:

“I did not grow up a Knicks fan. I hated the Knicks. I did not like Patrick Ewing. I did not like John Starks. I didn't like anything about the Knicks. I was a Bulls fan. I was a Michael Jordan fan. Michael Jordan is my GOAT.”

JR Smith on Michael Jordan, Patrick Ewing, John Starks, Jun 10, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Andre Drummond on Michael Jordan
item.description:
“My GOAT is Michael Jordan,by default. My mom is a super Michael Jordan fan, so that is who I grew up hearing about all day and all night.”

Andre Drummond on Michael Jordan, Jun 2, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Ricky Rubio on Michael Jordan, Shaquille O'Neal, Stephen Curry, Victor Wembanyama
item.description:
Ricky Rubio:

“Victor Wembanyama, one of the rare few capable of changing the NBA game, like Stephen Curry, Michael Jordan, or Shaquille O'Neal.”

Ricky Rubio on Michael Jordan, Shaquille O'Neal, Stephen Curry, Victor Wembanyama, May 28, 2026. Source: L'Equipe.

item.title: Tim Hardaway Sr. on Michael Jordan
item.description:
“If Penny didn't get hurt, him and Michael Jordan would have been 1-2 MVPs in the league.”

Tim Hardaway Sr. on Michael Jordan, May 13, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Jerry Stackhouse on Michael Jordan, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
item.description:
Jerry Stackhouse:

“I mean, from some skill standpoints, he’s probably better. He’s a better ball handler than Michael Jordan was. I think he’s a better facilitator than Michael Jordan was. Was he a better scorer than Michael Jordan? No. Was he a better clutch performer? No. Michael Jordan went to the Finals six times, won six championships, six Finals MVPs. So, to me, he’s always going to be the GOAT in my book. No matter what people might think, what might have happened in Washington, or where we didn’t see eye to eye, Michael Jordan is still the greatest player to ever put on a pair of basketball shoes in my mind. And I’m probably going to put Kareem after that.”

Jerry Stackhouse on Michael Jordan, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, May 12, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jerry Stackhouse on Michael Jordan
item.description:
Jerry Stackhouse on relationship with Michael Jordan:

“We weren’t sitting there every day butting heads. No, we were having a good time. I was going out there drinking some of those five-, six-thousand-dollar bottles of wine he was drinking every night. Playing cards on the plane and all that. So we did a lot of things together off the court as well.”

Jerry Stackhouse on Michael Jordan, May 12, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Michael Jordan
item.description:
“I was just chillin’ at the house last week, and one of my good friends is Vince Coleman, the great baseball player. When we answer the phone, we (jokingly) say some unkind words to each other … he says, ‘Yo, I’m down here at The Grove. I’m sick of you and MJ’s BS. He’s right here. Y’all need to talk.’And we had a conversation, but Vince Coleman’s the person who’s responsible. We (Barkley and Jordan) talked for a couple minutes. He said, ‘Man, let’s get together and play golf. And as soon as I get a break, we’re gonna fly down there and spend a couple days playing golf.’”

Charles Barkley on Michael Jordan, Apr 22, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Tracy McGrady on Michael Jordan
item.description:
Tracy McGrady:

“It is good to be Michael Jordan. With KD, that had to be a great feeling, man, to hear your name being mentioned and passing the great Michael Jordan. It is the longevity for me, these guys are great. They're the greatest to do it and when you have that type of skillset and you have the ability to go out and be it.”

Tracy McGrady on Michael Jordan, Apr 1, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Ime Udoka on Michael Jordan
item.description:
“And as KD has said in the past, I don’t think he cares much about it in the moment. He’s really focused on the season and what we’re trying to accomplish, but I don’t want to just make it an afterthought. Passing Michael Jordan is obviously a huge accomplishment and we celebrated that with him.”

Ime Udoka on Michael Jordan, Mar 22, 2026. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Michael Jordan
item.description:
“Michael Jordan has always been my inspiration. There’s a reason why I wanted to be able to knock down those shots,”

Kevin Durant on Michael Jordan, Mar 20, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: David Adelman on Michael Jordan
item.description:
David Adelman on Michael Jordan:

“It was a different thing. And on the road, when he’d run out of a tunnel, the murmurs in the crowd. And in Chicago, when he’d run out of the tunnel and that place would start shaking—there’s, I’ve never been around anything like it since. Nothing comes close to just his presence. When he came to a game. So yeah, that was very cool to be a part of. Unfortunately, lost the Finals to him, too.”

David Adelman on Michael Jordan, Feb 23, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kevin Johnson on Michael Jordan
item.description:
“I see a church across the street. I walked straight in that church, I sat in that front row and I said, ‘Jesus, I don’t believe in you no more. There’s no way if you loved me and died on the cross and did all these things that you’d have me guard Michael Jordan.’”

Kevin Johnson on Michael Jordan, Feb 12, 2026. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Juan Toscano-Anderson on LeBron James, Michael Jordan
item.description:
Toscano-Anderson said in an exclusive interview.

“Again, I didn’t watch Michael Jordan play. I was born in ’93, I wasn’t introduced to basketball until about ’99, and that’s when kinda started to watch, but I didn’t really watch Michael Jordan at all, so for all the people who may read this or hear this, forgive me, but from a basketball standpoint, LeBron James, in his prime, didn’t have a hole in his game.”

Juan Toscano-Anderson on LeBron James, Michael Jordan, Feb 10, 2026. Source: Basketball Network.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Michael Jordan
item.description:
“Even though [Jordan] had won the championship, he still felt like he had something in the tank to give,”

Kevin Durant on Michael Jordan, Feb 4, 2026. Source: The Ringer.
